meta.title: IDA MCP bridge
meta.description: Connects the Hex-Rays IDA MCP server in this repository over stdio and exposes its six tools as mcp__ida__*: open a binary in IDA, run IDAPython to decompile and disassemble, look up the ida-domain API, list or save databases, and release the session's database lease. Installing the bundle is enough: on first start it installs a private ida-mcp runtime via uv (network or a warm uv cache required); later starts run offline. Requires IDA 9.4+ with a valid license, idalib, uv, and Git. Opening a new binary creates a .i64 beside it. Headless idalib is the default; the IDA GUI path needs a current ida-nexus plugin installed inside IDA and IDA_NEXUS_IDALIB_ONLY=0 in the dsh environment. IDA auto-analysis and Python execution can take minutes, so a tool call may wait up to 7 minutes. Tool schemas join every request while the bundle is enabled. A failed startup leaves the row failed until the environment is fixed and Harness reloads or restarts.
